coords.how: Field inches, origin at the field top left (what ctx.U positions in a sheet or overlay). Plan: fx = fx[0] * x + fx[1], fy = fy[0] * z + fy[1]. Ortho view: h = x * right[0] + z * right[1]; fx = fx[0] * h + fx[1]; fy = fy[0] * (el - 5990) + fy[1].

grids.note: Walls on their outside face (the footprint), glulams and posts on their centerline, from the model. Numbers are N to S lines, one label per physical line across the house, west to east; letters run E to W, north to south. Beams off the grid are reference lines.
